about_the_game: In the demo of Alex: An Adventure Between the Ages, Alex has a prophetic dream in which he looks into the future of his adventures. In this dream, he meets his friend Carl, as well as a host of intriguing characters and mysterious locations. These dream visions connect him to the world that lies ahead, filled with unexpected encounters and adventures.

short_description: Dive into a dark, but quite funny story about a schoolboy who fell into another world and now cannot get out of there. Help Alex to pass through all the trials that will come his way. Solve puzzles, escape from monsters, and try to find out what's going on.
